For now, make decisions that help you manage today. Consider counseling to process and express your emotions healthily, regardless of your ultimate course. Pack clothes for work or family visits—this isn't about packing up your whole life.

Start a journal. Write about every feeling, no matter how small or fleeting. This can help clarify your thoughts and needs.

Take time for yourself. Rediscover hobbies or connect with old friends. It's important not to isolate even during such a difficult transition.

If you decide to divorce, start collecting necessary documentation, setting up legal accounts, and possibly seeking financial advice. The process can be overwhelming, so plan in advance.

If you opt instead for reconciliation, reach out when your husband suggests it. Open communication might restore some of the intimacy lost if both parties are willing to work through issues together.

Regardless of your next step, know that you deserve respect and happiness.
